description: This file defines the InvestStatusChangerListener class, which listens to controller events in a Symfony-based PHP application to manage investment status changes, session handling, and user notifications related to investments.

classes.name: InvestStatusChangerListener
classes.description: Listener class for handling investment status changes and session management during controller events.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Handles controller events to manage investment status updates, session user switching, and notifications based on the controller action.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this listener subscribes to, specifically the KernelEvents::CONTROLLER event.
